run_generator_trainstep: run a generator training step using the Trainer class with latent z and condition y
run_discriminator_trainstep: run a discriminator training step using the Trainer class with real data, condition y, and latent z
create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with generator, discriminator, optimizers, gan_type, reg_type, and reg_param
compute_loss: compute the GAN loss using binary cross entropy or WGAN loss depending on gan_type
update_average: update a target model's parameters with an exponential moving average of the source model
